name: an initial soc outside its own bounds
description: **The clamp that does not happen.** The spec names this case on its own: an initial state of charge outside `[min, max]` is an error, never a clamp. Clamping 0.98 to the default 0.95 would plan for a battery holding 9 MWh less than the one described, and nothing in the response would say so.
